title: Story insights and search state kept as loading bool plus error plus request
trigger: n/a
effect: StoryInsightsState has forwards_loading beside forwards_error; StorySearchState has loading beside error and an Option<RequestId> that is the real stage; load_more flips loading before the send decides whether a request goes out.
fix: StorySearchState::page: Fetch{Idle|Loading(RequestId)|Failed}; same for forwards.

title: Story insights forwards and the public story search hold loading bools beside error Options
trigger: Story statistics forwards; public story search paging.
effect: StoryInsightsState::forwards_loading/forwards_error and StorySearchState::loading/error/request are three fields of one stage kept in step by hand.
fix: One page enum per list: Idle | Loading{request} | Failed(String).

title: Viewer panels are eight independent bools/Options that must be mutually exclusive by hand
trigger: open stats, share, privacy editor, cover picker, viewers, report, close friends in the story viewer
effect: reaction_picker_open, reply_open, reply_panel, viewers_open, stats_open, report_open, share_open, menu_open, privacy_edit, cover, close_friends_edit are each cleared by some togglers and missed by others
fix: enum ViewerPanel { None, ReactionPicker, Reply{panel}, Viewers, Stats, Report, Share, CloseFriends(edit), Privacy(edit), Cover(picker) } plus menu_open as part of it

title: Close-friends editor: close_friends_edit Option + close_friends_saving bool + page_op Option<RequestId> change together
trigger: open Edit close friends from the menu or privacy editor and Save
effect: leave_item copies all three by hand to survive a story change; the saving flag and page_op can disagree
fix: CloseFriendsStage { Loading, Editing, Saving(RequestId) } (same enum as the bug entry)

title: tick_active bool guards the viewer tick task; stealth_box + stealth_tick + stealth_toast are three Options for one box stage
trigger: open the viewer; open Stealth Mode
effect: a started-flag next to the task it guards, and a box whose open Option, ticker Option and toast Option are set/cleared together by hand (close_stealth_box clears two, the toast is never cleared)
fix: enum StoryTick { Off, Running(Task) } and a StealthBox variant that owns its tick Task; toast owned by the viewer UI value

title: Statistics panel paging uses InsightsState.forwards_loading bool beside forwards_error, and Asked counters in the UI
trigger: scroll the public shares list
effect: loading and error are two fields; the 'asked at length' memo is a third
fix: Fetch<Page> for the shares list

title: Viewer panels are separate bools (reaction_picker_open, reply_open, share_open, report_open, viewers_open, stats_open, menu_open) plus Options and *_sent marks
trigger: n/a
effect: story_playback_paused ORs eleven fields. Opening is mutually excluded only by hand: toggle_story_viewers clears report_open but not stats_open/share_open/reaction_picker_open/reply_open, toggle_story_report clears viewers_open only, so two panels can show at once (S4).
fix: enum ViewerPanel { None, Reaction, Reply{panel}, Viewers, Report, Stats, Share, Cover, Privacy, CloseFriends } with `paused()` derived from it; *_sent become the editors' own stage enums.

title: StoryUi::tick_active bool guards the 100 ms tick task (Option<Task> in step by hand)
trigger: n/a
effect: Cleared only inside the task when the viewer is not open; a task that stops any other way (screen dropped, update Err) leaves it true. spawn_screen is replaced with OnScreen so today it is safe.
fix: Hold the tick as Option<Task> owned by StoryUi so dropping it stops it and the flag disappears.

title: Thread open stage is status plus needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed
trigger: n/a
effect: ThreadView::status, needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set in step by switch_to_thread_chat, begin_thread_reading, fetch_thread_history and the reducer; the UI polls thread_needs_start each frame to decide which step is due.
fix: ThreadStage enum {Resolving, SwitchingChat, Starting, Loading, Ready, Failed} with reload as a Ready sub-variant.

title: ThreadView's load stage is status plus three bools kept in step by hand
trigger: Any thread open: needs_chat_switch, reading_started and reload_needed are set by the reducer and cleared by the driver around ThreadStatus.
effect: Combinations like LoadingHistory + reading_started with no request in flight are representable: start_thread_in_open_chat sets reading_started before fetch_thread_history, so a send error leaves the thread loading with nothing to retry it (plausible stuck spinner).
fix: One enum: Resolving{request} | SwitchingChat | Starting | LoadingFirst{request} | Ready | ReloadNeeded | Failed(String), each with what leaves it.

title: Paged<T> and MoneyPage keep loading/loaded/error as separate fields
trigger: n/a
effect: History and NFT lists carry loading, loaded and error that apply()/fail() keep in step; MoneyPage::close/open resets the whole page while an earlier page request is still in flight, so its late answer lands in the new page (append onto an empty list).
fix: Paged<T> holds a Fetch-like enum (Idle/Loading{append}/Ready/Failed) and a page token compared with the answer.

title: Paged<T> holds loading/loaded/error bools beside each other, and page answers carry no page key
trigger: fetch_wallet_history/fetch_wallet_nfts set loading=true and error=None. apply sets loading=false, loaded=true and error=None, and fail sets loading=false and error. Closing and reopening the Money page while a page request is in flight lets the old answer (keyed only by purpose and append) land on the new page and clear its loading while the new request is still out.
effect: Today the list corrects itself when the newer answer lands, but loading can read false while a request is in flight. `loaded && error.is_some()` and `loading && error` are representable.
fix: Use a `Fetch`-like stage, e.g. `PageStage { Idle, Loading { offset: String }, Ready, Failed(String) }`, and put the asked offset (or a page generation) in the purpose, so an answer applies only to the request that is current.

title: Money page detail view is five fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Every detail transition: show_wallet_transaction, select_wallet_nft, money_back, set_money_tab and open_wallet_transaction each clear a different subset of selected_tx / selected_nft / tx_loading / tx_error / hint_open.
effect: Two of them can be set at once, for example selected_tx together with tx_loading (see 07-4-001), or selected_nft together with tx_error. The render order in ui/ton_wallet_money.rs:197-208 decides which one wins.
fix: `enum MoneyDetail { Overview, Tx { tx: WalletTx, hint: bool }, Nft(String), TxLookup { id: String }, TxFailed(String) }` as the one field of the page's detail stage.

title: TonWalletState uses three 'in flight or done' bools for the app config, wallet state and exchange-rate requests
trigger: fetch_ton_explorer_url, open_money_page and set_can_use set and clear explorer_url_requested, state_requested and rates_requested by hand. One bool stands for both 'asked' and 'answered'.
effect: The value cannot tell an in-flight request from a finished one or a failed one, so a failure path has to remember to clear it (see 07-4-005).
fix: Use one `Fetch<()>`/`Fetch<Rates>` per request (idle, loading, ready, failed), and have the error arm of each purpose move it to failed so it can be retried.

title: parameters_sent bool shadows the auth state it follows
trigger: n/a
effect: ConnectDriver::parameters_sent is set after setTdlibParameters is sent and gates both maybe_send_parameters and network_tick; the real stage is session.auth (WaitTdlibParameters, StartupFailed on error), so two values are kept in step.
fix: Handshake enum {NotSent, Sent(RequestId)} owned with the auth state, or derive from auth and the pending SetParameters request.

title: Draft save is a clock, a token, and an Option that must change together
trigger: n/a
effect: draft_clock, draft_save_token and pending_draft (token, chat, topic, content) are updated by hand in several driver methods; same shape for search_debounce_token with pending_typed_search and chat_search_debounce_token with pending_typed_chat_search.
fix: A Debounce<T> value {Idle|Armed{token,value}} that owns the token.

title: Mini-app launch is a Vec of pending contexts plus single one-shot Option slots
trigger: n/a
effect: Launch stage is spread over WebApps::pending, open_result, dropped_launches and the one-shot found/write_access/emoji_access/phone_share/data_sent/attachment_menu_* slots, each cleared by hand at the start of the next call.
fix: One enum per flow (Launch{Pending(RequestId,ctx)|Opened|Failed|Dropped}) keyed by request id; grossing_loading becomes Fetch<Vec<i64>>.

title: WebApps grossing_loading bool beside grossing_bots Option
trigger: Apps tab.
effect: A Fetch held as a bool plus an Option (failure is an empty Some); the one-shot answer slots beside it are a second pattern of unkeyed results.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the grossing bots.

title: Apps tab reads grossing_loading bool beside grossing_bots Option (a hand-made Fetch)
trigger: Open global search > Apps while getGrossingWebAppBots fails.
effect: The failure turns into an empty list, so the tab says 'No apps to show right now' instead of an error with retry; loading and loaded are two fields.
fix: Fetch<Vec<i64>> for the grossing list, with the failure arm shown in the tab.

title: Auto-download prefs: seeded bool beside an external loading flag and an error
trigger: n/a
effect: 'Loading…' is derived from DataStoragePrefs::seeded plus SettingsState::auto_download_presets_loading plus data_storage_error; storage_limits_seeded is a second one-way stage flag.
fix: Fetch<DataStoragePrefs> for the presets seed; persist only the seeded values.

title: StorageScroll stage kept in pending + until_settled + placed
trigger: n/a: a scroll request, a repeat-once-settled request and the offset last placed are three fields kept in step in ensure_storage_scroll.
effect: n/a
fix: enum StorageScrollStage { Idle, Requested, WaitingSettled{placed}, Placed{offset} }.

title: Storage stats and auto-download presets are Option/seeded data beside loading bools
trigger: n/a
effect: storage_stats + storage_stats_loading, and data_storage.seeded + auto_download_presets_loading, are each kept in step by hand (error arms do clear them).
fix: `storage_stats: Fetch<StorageStats>` and `presets: Fetch<Presets>`.

title: DiskState::confirmed takes the 'armed once' bool from the caller
trigger: Disk free space falls below the close floor
effect: DiskState, below_once (DiskUi::confirming), screen_refused, held_for_call and start_refused (ui/disk_state.rs) together describe one disk stage but are separate fields; DiskClients is rebuilt from them each reading
fix: enum DiskStage { Healthy, Low, FullPending, Full { held_for_call }, Refused } owned by DiskUi, with confirmed() a method on it

title: EarnLimits.app_config_loaded is a 'asked once' flag with two writers
trigger: Open any profile or earn page
effect: The flag is set by the groups reducer on success and by the earn error arm, and ensure_earn_app_config also checks an in-flight GetBoostsPerGift; a failed send is never recorded so it is retried on every call
fix: Fetch<AppConfig> from src/state/fetch.rs

title: EarnPage.ton_unavailable bool beside ton: Load
trigger: BROADCAST_REQUIRED for a megagroup
effect: The reducer sets ton_unavailable=true and resets ton to Idle; Load has no 'not applicable' stage so the page needs the extra bool
fix: Add a Load::Unavailable stage (or Option<Load>)

title: WithdrawStep::Password carries sending: bool and error: Option<String> that can both be set
trigger: Submit the 2FA password of a Stars or TON withdrawal
effect: sending and error are kept in step by hand in connect/earn.rs and apply_withdrawal_error
fix: Split into Password { error: Option<String> } and PasswordSending; the sending stage carries the request id

title: JoinBox.joining and RevokeBox.sending are stage bools next to the box Option
trigger: Join Program or Revoke Link clicked, then the answer or error arrives
effect: Box stage is held as a bool beside the Option, reset by hand in connect/earn.rs and the error arm of state/domains/payments/earn.rs
fix: enum JoinStage { Choosing, Joining(RequestId) } and RevokeStage { Asking, Sending(RequestId) }, so an answer is matched to its request id and cannot clear a newer box

title: Recipients load is a u8 counter plus Option list plus parked join box
trigger: Open a program with choose_recipient, or the bot profile Affiliate Program row
effect: recipients_loading (counts two requests down), recipients (None or Some) and pending_join must change together across connect/earn.rs and the payments reducer
fix: enum Recipients { Idle, Loading { chats: Pending, bots: Pending, join: Option<JoinBox> }, Ready(Vec<EarnPeer>), Failed }

title: setup_closed is a one-shot bool next to setup: Option
trigger: Save or End the affiliate program
effect: The reducer sets setup=None and setup_closed=true; the UI consumes the bool in drain_earn and open_starref_setup resets it by hand
fix: Return the 'go back' effect from the reducer as an event (EarnEffect::SetupDone) instead of a latched bool

title: EmojiPanel holds many stage flags kept in step by hand
trigger: Open Emoji Sets, the status picker or the chat Appearance box
effect: open, failed, mutation_failed, mutating_set, status_open, chat_status_open, status_note, pending_status_emoji, trending_stale, sticker_categories_asked and installed_loaded are written from connect/emoji_sets.rs, the stickers error arm and ui/emoji_sets.rs; failed is shared by the Installed, Trending and Search tabs
fields: EmojiPanel::open, EmojiPanel::failed, EmojiPanel::mutation_failed, EmojiPanel::mutating_set, EmojiPanel::status_open, EmojiPanel::chat_status_open, EmojiPanel::status_note, EmojiPanel::pending_status_emoji, EmojiPanel::sticker_categories_asked
fix: Per-tab Fetch<Vec<StickerSetInfo>> and a single enum for the status/appearance consumers; mutating_set as Option<Mutation{request,set,install}>

title: EmojiAnimations load stage is split between load, ready and waiting
trigger: Open a private chat that receives a lone emoji
effect: ready (bool) is set by apply_set, load by loading()/apply_set()/failed(), and waiting is cleared only by failed(); a lost request (never answered and not swept as an error) keeps Loading for two hours (load_due) with ready false
fix: enum Pack { Never, Loading{since,waiting}, Ready{asked,map}, Failed{asked} } so waiting lives only in Loading

title: Emoji set row state is derived from five separate fields of EmojiStyleUi
trigger: Settings, Choose emoji set: click Noto while another set downloads or failed
effect: SetState::of(id, current, ready, loading, failed) is recomputed from current, ready, download, failed and file_error that download_emoji_set, switch_emoji_set and install_emoji_set_file update by hand (ui/emoji_style_ui.rs)
fix: Store SetState per EmojiSetId in the UI (HashMap<EmojiSetId, SetState>) and mutate it only by transitions

title: SendGiftState keeps the gift list and the send as bools and Options in step by hand
trigger: Open Send a Gift, pick a gift, press Send, close and reopen.
effect: gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/error, premium_loaded (written, never read), sending + request + done + open are separate fields; both loaded/loading and error can be set.
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableGift>> for the list, Fetch for premium options, and enum SendStage { Idle, Sending(RequestId), Sent(String), Failed(String) }.

title: GiftManageState holds one-shot results and ask-once flags as bools and Options
trigger: Delete, transfer, or export a gift; open another gifts list.
effect: limits_asked (set before its requests), collections_loading/collections_stale, deleted, export_unlocked, export_url, transferred are hand-kept flags/hand-offs; reset_for_owner clears only some of them.
fix: Fetch<Limits> and Fetch<Vec<GiftCollection>> keyed by owner; one-shot results as an event queue Vec<GiftEvent> drained by the window that hosts the box.

title: One gift_mutating bool is the lock for ten different gift operations, plus export_unlocked beside TransferStage
trigger: Pin, transfer, upgrade, sell, set resale price, delete, collection edit
effect: gift_mutating is set by connect/gift_manage.rs and premium_hub.rs and cleared by every ok/error arm (lines 49, 109, 115, 138, 144, 191, 325, 346) regardless of which operation answered; manage.export_unlocked, deleting, collections_loading, collections_stale are further flags kept in step with flow/stage
fix: enum GiftMutation{Idle,Busy{request,kind}} and clear only on the matching request id; fold export_unlocked into TransferStage.

title: SendGiftState gifts_loading/gifts_loaded/sending/done/error stage flags
trigger: List loading, loaded, sending, sent ('done') and failed ('error') are separate fields read in build_send_gift_dialog.
effect: Both done and error can be set; sending beside them.
fix: Fetch<Vec<AvailableGift>> for the list and enum SendStage { Idle, Sending{request}, Sent, Failed }.

title: One-shot slots manage.export_url / transferred / deleted are drained by a per-frame upkeep
trigger: Not a bug today: Fragment URL, transferred toast and deleted toast are Option/bool slots taken by gift_transfer_frame_upkeep in the window that hosts GiftTransfer (or the last press).
effect: A slot not taken (hosting window gone, locked, hidden) stays set and fires later; any new producer needs the same drain by hand.
fix: Push these as events into a queue owned by the asking window (Asker) instead of slots on the session.
